statements.status_notes: Debian 13 (trixie) ships libgcrypt20 1.11.0-7 with no corrected package on the security tracker at the time of this statement. Upstream released fixes in Libgcrypt 1.11.3; waiting for Debian trixie security update.

Unimportant bug in libgcrypt outside of security policy of upstream maintainer
This CVE is not a direct vulnerability in libgcrypt but in applications using it insecurely. This is not the case here.
